thread:
Harper Lane: Dropping a focused pass for the landing page split + launch funnel experiments. Goal: clear funnel for Hosted / Dedicated / Private rows, defensible microbenchmarks for social, and routing that minimizes AE back-and-forth. Drafts in drive: https://drive.google.com/mock-landing-experiments
Diego Alvarez: Love it. Quick priorities: 1) CTAs that map to different intake flows, 2) a small benchmark line under each hero that includes model + seq, 3) A/B plan for Dedicated CTA wording.
Maya Singh: CTA set proposal: Hosted -> "Start free API trial" (no CC); Dedicated -> primary "Estimate capacity" / variant "Reserve compute" (A/B); Private -> "Schedule secure deployment demo". Webinar CTA -> "Join: LLM serving at production scale".
Owen Brooks: For inbound routing I propose these simple scalar fields (HubForms friendly): `deploy_type`, `peak_rps`, `budget_band`, `compliance_flags`. Middleware maps to SFDC. Snippet:
```
/landing?deploy=hosted -> trial-hosted (hidden: deploy_type=hosted)
/landing?deploy=dedicated -> lead-dedicated (fields: peak_rps, model_family, budget_band)
/landing?deploy=private -> enterprise-sales (fields: compliance_flags, onprem)
/webinar/register -> nurture:webinar-llm-prod
```
This keeps the form payloads flat and predictable.
Fiona Reed: Benchmarks: infra can validate 1-line stats for each path. Suggested microcopy: Hosted: "p95 ~ XX ms on open-medium (2k seq)"; Dedicated: "p99 SLA demonstrated at Y qps (2k seq)"; Private: "sample on-prem run: p95 ~ ZZ ms (customer infra varies)". Always append a tiny methodology note.
Harper Lane: Good. For social we need three short hooks per channel: X short (110 chars), LinkedIn long (company + product value + CTA), and an image concept. Diego, can you draft those?
Diego Alvarez: On it. Also suggest we add a tiny UI affordance on the Dedicated CTA: a quick toggle "Quick estimate" vs "Deep sizing". Quick estimate = 3 fields -> faster conversion, Deep sizing = schedule call. That should reduce AE churn.
Maya Singh: For webinar gating, add: "Which deployment are you evaluating?" (hosted / dedicated / private) and "Do you require compliance review pre-demo?" If they pick Private + yes -> auto-create ticket for Solutions with `compliance: true`. Also add checkbox "Request pre-webinar sizing consult" for Dedicated.
Owen Brooks: Mapping rules: if `budget_band` > $50k -> priority AE tag; if `compliance_flags` contains SOC2 or FedRAMP -> compliance AE. I'll draft middleware rules. Keep field names lower_snake_case to avoid integration issues.
Fiona Reed: Benchmarks ETA: I'll get p95/p99, tokens/sec, and $/1k tokens for three canonical configs (open baseline, quantized, optimized). Will include model name, seq len, test date, and one-line methodology. Deliverable Mon AM.
Harper Lane: Tone notes for copy: developer-friendly for Hosted (short, action-led), practical + trust for Dedicated (capacity numbers + sizing language), enterprise-trust for Private (compliance, KMS, audit logs). Avoid one-off claims like "fastest" unless backed by our benchmarks.
Diego Alvarez: A/B test plan for Dedicated CTA: run 50/50 on traffic -> metric: submit-rate on hub form. Variant A: "Estimate capacity". Variant B: "Reserve compute". We'll measure conversion to AE-qualified lead within 7 days.
Maya Singh: UX microcopy tweaks: label Private as "Private deployment (VPC / on-prem)" everywhere. For Dedicated hero subline: "Reserved GPU pools with predictable p99 and optional burst capacity." Hosted hero subline: "API access in minutes  ideal for prototypes and pilots."
Owen Brooks: One operational note: include a hidden utm param `utm_campaign=llm_launch_q2` on all CTAs for attribution. Also send `initial_referrer` so we can stitch journey.
Fiona Reed: Small copy for benchmark footnote example: "Tested with open-medium, 2k seq, avg of 5 runs; quantized variant uses int8. See methodology link." Keep it short.
Harper Lane: Action items:
- Fiona: benchmark numbers + 3 microcards + methodology blurb (due Mon 9am)
- Diego: social variants X + LinkedIn + image notes + A/B setup (due Mon 12pm)
- Maya: finalize CTA microcopy, webinar gating questions, and modal copy for Dedicated quick-estimate (due Mon 12pm)
- Owen: hub form field list + middleware mapping + utm plan (due Tue)
I'll open the landing-copy PR once CTAs and benchmark lines are in. Scheduling 20m async review Tue morning. Ping me if anything blocks. :rocket:
